loops.name: Test Until Green
loops.goal: Make the test suite pass. Fix failing tests and the code under test until everything is green.

loops.name: Build Until Green
loops.goal: Make the project build successfully. Fix compile/build errors until the build is clean.

loops.name: Lint Until Clean
loops.goal: Eliminate all lint errors and warnings without changing behavior.

loops.name: Typecheck Until Pass
loops.goal: Resolve all type errors. Do not weaken types with `any` or `@ts-ignore` unless unavoidable and justified.

loops.name: Gradle Build Until Green
loops.goal: Make the Android debug build succeed. Fix Kotlin compile errors until assembleDebug passes.
